# Standards

The canonical [LaTeX standard](../../docs/standards/latex.md) lives in `docs/standards/` alongside
[writing](../../docs/standards/writing.md), [compilation](../../docs/standards/compilation.md), and
[glossary/notation](../../docs/standards/glossary-and-notation.md) policies.

This directory is a navigation pointer, not a second standards registry. Add durable rules to the
canonical documents, focused examples to `latex/patterns/`, and project-specific overrides to the
consuming project's documentation.
